pr_title: GameEngine: fix ACP MCP permission classification
pr_body:
## Summary

- preserve provider-declared stable GameEngine MCP tool identity across ACP tool-call correlation
- classify exact registered Editor MCP tools through the existing MCP read/write contract while failing closed for unknown tools
- distinguish host policy/classification rejection from explicit user denial
- terminalize returned ACP turns whose required provider completion gates cannot proceed, avoiding permanent Executing state
- add focused ACP permission and completion regression coverage and update ADR 0166

## Validation

Use the repository Windows Validation workflow and inspect the selected affected scope and aggregate summary.
